Treepower New Energy Co., Ltd. Solar PV Systems Engineer — Ploiești, Romania 
 ☀️ From an available rooftop to a practical solar design. 
 We’re looking for an engineer who can assess a commercial or industrial site and turn the available information into a clear PV system proposal. 
 You’ll review roof dimensions, shading, electricity consumption and connection constraints; compare system sizes; and select suitable modules and inverters. The work also involves preparing layouts and coordinating structural and electrical questions with qualified specialists. 
 A good fit for this role 
Experience in electrical engineering, renewable energy or PV design.
Confidence reading technical drawings and checking equipment specifications.
A practical approach to explaining design choices and documenting assumptions.
 💰 Target gross salary: RON 11,000/month 
 🏠 Housing support, company vehicle and business travel allowance. 
 Interested? Send your CV with a short description of a solar design you worked on and the part you personally handled.
